content:
The Laredo Police Department has opened registration for Blue Santa 2026, the department's annual holiday toy drive for children in the community.

Parents can register their children November 2 through November 6 and again November 9 through November 10, from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM, at Laredo Police Department headquarters, 4712 Maher Avenue in Laredo.

Parents must bring the child's grades or birth certificate when registering.

Toy delivery is set for Thursday, December 17, 2026, at Sames Auto Arena.

Update — November 9, 2026

Laredo police are holding their final Blue Santa toy program sign-ups this week: Monday and Tuesday, Nov. 9–10, from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. at 4712 Maher Avenue, according to KGNS. The program is for children 10 years old and younger. Families should bring a valid ID, a report card for elementary school children, and a birth certificate for children not yet in school. Toy distribution is Dec. 17, from 5 p.m. to 9 p.m., at the Sames Auto Arena.

Source: Laredo Police Department, November 5, 2026.

Sources: KGNS, November 9, 2026.
